verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਪਾਰਸ ਭਏ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal saran gur ka(n)chan bhe manoor ka(n)chan paaras bhe paaras paras kai ||

en.bdb: By acquiring the philosophical stone-like art of Naam Simran in the refuge of the lotus-like feet of True Guru, the mammon-entangled living beings who are like iron sludge turn into bright and shining gold. They become like the True Guru Himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਇਸ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਹੰਸ ਹੰਸ ਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁ ਰਸ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bais bhe hai ha(n)s ha(n)s te param ha(n)s charan kamal charanaamirat su ras kai ||

en.bdb: By enjoying the nectar-like union with True Guru's feet, crow-like low people also become wise and rational like swans, and then attain wise and supreme intelligence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਂਬਲ ਸਕਲ ਫਲ ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਾਂਸ ਸੂਕਰੀ ਸੈ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਬਰਸ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: se(n)bal sakal fal sakal suga(n)dh baa(n)s sookaree sai kaamadhen karunaa baras kai ||

en.bdb: Through the Guru's blessings a Silk Tree like deceitful person becomes fruitful. A bamboo like egoistic person becomes humble, submissive and fragrant. A pig like polluted person becomes kind hearted and does good for everyone like the cow Kamdhen.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਨਮਸ ਕੈ ॥੨੪੯॥
verses.translit_en: sree gur charan raj mahimaa agaadh bodh log bedh giaan koT bisam namas kai ||249||

en.bdb: Understanding grandeur of the dust of Satguru’s lotus feet is very difficult. Millions of marvellous knowledge of Vedas are astonished too and bow before such knowledge. (249)
